column2: # 中文：levels() 返回因子的所有已登记水平名称，而不是每组样本数；返回顺序也决定默认绘图或模型中的类别顺序。
# English: levels() returns all registered factor level names, not group counts; their order also affects default plotting and modelling order.
# 中文：先创建因子再 filter() 后，某些空类别的水平可能仍保留，所以 levels() 长度不一定等于当前有观测的组数。
# English: Filtering after factor creation can retain unused levels, so the length of levels() need not equal the number of groups with current observations.
# 中文：了解类别数量有助于判断图是否过于拥挤；若需判断稀疏程度，还需另查每组非缺失评分数。
# English: Category counts help assess visual clutter; assessing sparse groups also requires counts of nonmissing ratings within each group.
